scope: Static delta review only; no candidate import, compilation, tests or execution; no source edits.
positive: Full inventories removed from 64 matrix result bodies and retained in CAS keyed by exact label version; source-path versions preserve scenario-dependent clocks.
Each encoded inventory is limited to 4 MiB and encoded matrix to 64 MiB before publication.

CLI checks declared unique finite inventory, rejects undeclared and unused references, verifies first-use payload hash/version/population/target, and checks later shared uses against population/target.
F01 resolves actual retained label artifact, F02 expects16 inventories and branch sharing, F03 hydrates retained expected labels before restart parity.
Final measured inner CPU/wall/RSS bounds are strict and checked after matrix artifact writing and before successful finish.

findings.issue: Declared <=4 MiB does not bound actual read: ArtifactStore.read calls Path.read_bytes before checking actual size/hash; no regular-file/no-symlink check at this loader.
findings.recommendation: Read label blobs through bounded regular-file/no-symlink validation and enforce actual length/hash before JSON decode.

findings.issue: Label/result join checks population and target but lacks scenario/source-path join. A same-target permutation of scenario label references remains declared/used and passes all current joins even though clock versions differ.
findings.recommendation: Retain scenario version and per-day source-path versions on both result and inventory, then verify equality for every referenced inventory. Add focused swap-negative assertion within existing helper.

budget_assessment: At most16 declared 4MiB inventories plus <=64MiB matrix gives <=128MiB for these artifact categories alone; remaining retained trial/journal/model data is outside this bound. Actual output and total store sizes remain unmeasured.
